mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving-laboratory passage was most worthwhile: the second pair of hands and the silence give the discovery a sense of weight without claiming to explain it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final board felt unnecessary after the ending, since it offered no actions or goals.

surprise.text: The story ends with the folded limbs coming into view at the receiving laboratory, leaving their significance unresolved.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored what the laboratory learns. The ending leaves me curious about the specimens.
